description: This file implements the ShoppingCartFacade interface, providing methods to manage shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating items, and retrieving shopping cart data within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacadeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade interface, handling shopping cart operations such as add, remove, update, and retrieve within the e-commerce system.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart identified by its ID or code.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart, creating a new cart if necessary, and recalculates totals.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new ShoppingCart model instance with a specified code, merchant store, and optional customer.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data for a given customer and store, or by cart code.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart by its ID.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific item in the cart.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Batch updates multiple cart items with new quantities.

methods.name: getCartModel
methods.description: Fetches a shopping cart model by its code.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart for a specific customer.
